mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Scripted inverse-kinematics controller for the frozen ALOHA hand-over."""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('RCB_MUJOCO_GL','egl')
import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
import rcb_aloha as ra
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s=ra.Session('/app/instance.json')
        self.m,self.d=self.s.model,self.s.data
        self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.arms={}
        self.qdes={}
        self.grip={'left':.037,'right':.037}
        self.integ={}
        for side in ['left','right']:
            names=[side+'/'+j for j in ['waist','shoulder','elbow','forearm_roll','wrist_angle','wrist_rotate']]
            aids=np.array([self.m.actuator(n).id for n in names])
            jids=self.m.actuator_trnid[aids,0]
            qa=self.m.jnt_qposadr[jids]; da=self.m.jnt_dofadr[jids]
            self.arms[side]=(aids,qa,da,self.m.site(side+'/gripper').id)
            self.qdes[side]=self.d.qpos[qa].copy()
            self.integ[side]=np.zeros(6)
        self.s.record_start()
    def pose(self,side):
        sid=self.arms[side][3]
        return self.d.site_xpos[sid].copy(),self.d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def ik(self,side,p,R,q0=None):
        aids,qa,da,sid=self.arms[side]
        self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
        q=self.qdes[side].copy() if q0 is None else q0.copy()
        lo=self.m.jnt_range[self.m.actuator_trnid[aids,0],0]+.0001
        hi=self.m.jnt_range[self.m.actuator_trnid[aids,0],1]-.0001
        jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=np.zeros_like(jp)
        for i in range(100):
            self.k.qpos[qa]=q
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
            curR=self.k.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3)
            ep=p-self.k.site_xpos[sid]
            er=Rotation.from_matrix(R@curR.T).as_rotvec()
            if np.linalg.norm(ep)<.00003 and np.linalg.norm(er)<.0002: break
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,sid)
            J=np.vstack((jp[:,da],.25*jr[:,da]))
            e=np.r_[ep,.25*er]
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-6,e)
            q=np.clip(q+dq*min(1,.15/max(np.max(np.abs(dq)),1e-8)),lo,hi)
        return q, np.linalg.norm(ep),np.linalg.norm(er)
    def tick(self):
        u=self.s.targets.copy()
        for side,(aids,qa,da,sid) in self.arms.items():
            err=self.qdes[side]-self.d.qpos[qa]
            self.integ[side]=np.clip(self.integ[side]+.02*err,-.15,.15)
            u[aids]=self.qdes[side]+self.d.qfrc_bias[da]/self.m.actuator_gainprm[aids,0]+.25*err+.8*self.integ[side]
            u[self.m.actuator(side+'/gripper').id]=self.grip[side]
        return self.s.step(u)
    def move(self,side,p,R=None,n=150,settle=50):
        p=np.array(p,dtype=float)
        p0,R0=self.pose(side)
        if R is None:R=R0
        rotvec=Rotation.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()
        for i in range(n):
            t=(i+1)/n; t=t*t*(3-2*t)
            pt=p0+(p-p0)*t
            Rt=Rotation.from_rotvec(t*rotvec).as_matrix()@R0
            q,ep,er=self.ik(side,pt,Rt)
            self.qdes[side]=q
            self.tick()
        for i in range(settle): self.tick()
        print('move',side,'requested',p,'actual',self.pose(side)[0], 'IK err',ep,er,flush=True)
        self.report()
    def hold(self,n=80):
        for i in range(n):self.tick()
    def report(self):
        print(self.s.check(),'box',self.d.xpos[self.s._box].copy(),flush=True)
        cs=[]
        for c in self.d.contact[:self.d.ncon]:
            if self.s._box_geom in [c.geom1,c.geom2]:cs.append((self.m.geom(c.geom1).name,self.m.geom(c.geom2).name,round(c.dist,5)))
        print('contacts',cs,flush=True)
    def snap(self,name):
        Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
    def close(self):
        if self.s._renderer is not None:self.s._renderer.close()

def main():
    c=Controller()
    box=c.d.xpos[c.s._box].copy()
    down=Rotation.from_euler('y',90,degrees=True).as_matrix()
    c.move('left',box+[0,0,.17],down)
    c.snap('above')
    c.move('left',box+[0,0,.015],down,n=180)
    c.snap('pregrasp')
    c.grip['left']=.002;c.hold(120);c.report();c.snap('grasp')
    c.move('left',box+[0,0,.23],down,n=200)
    c.snap('lift')
    a=c.s.record_stop();c.s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/trial.npz')
    c.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
